scope: Catch allocation exceptions from DWG and DXF LWPOLYLINE vertex shared-object allocation so they return through each parser's existing failure path.

implementation.behavior: An internal noexcept factory catches std::make_shared failures. DWG parsing routes a null vertex through fail(), which invalidates the source buffer and resets the entity. DXF parseCode returns false on a null vertex, and now increments the field occurrence only after allocation/insertion succeeds so a failed allocation leaves parser state retryable. Both paths reserve their pointer vectors through DRW::reserve before appending; the DWG loop therefore does not allocate vector capacity per vertex.
implementation.failureInjection: Not available in these parser paths; exception handling and each return route were source-reviewed, not fault-injected.
